shortDescription: Italian design group Pininfarina MIL:PINF said on Wednesday that PF Holdings, a Dutch special purpose entity owned by India's Tech Mahindra NSE:TECHM and Mahindra & Mahindra NSE:M&M, has launched a voluntary tender offer for the company's shares.Here are some additional details:

children: said on Wednesday that PF Holdings, a Dutch special purpose entity owned by India's Tech Mahindra
, has launched a voluntary tender offer for the company's shares.
PF Holdings will pay 1 euro per share in cash for each share tendered, Pininfarina said.
PF Holdings, which already owns 78.8% of Pininfarina, launched a tender offer for up to 16.7 million shares, representing 21.2% of the Italian design group's shares, the company added.
The offer represents an about 18% premium to Pininfarina's last close, according to Reuters calculations.
The company said that the offer is aimed at delisting Pininfarina from Euronext Milan.
